content:
The focus here was on a husband's unilateral sale of stocks and the
 liquidation of an insurance policy during a marital crisis,. 
The court interpreted the implied mandate of spouses to manage movable assets. 
The interpretive problem was determining when this mandate ends.
 The court held that once the separation process is formalized, the implicit
 consent for one spouse to manage joint titles is revoked; 
consequently, the husband was ordered to "reconstruct" the community's value to compensate for the unauthorized sales.
